title: I Need Thee every Hour
lyrics_original: I need thee, oh, I need thee;
Oh, bless me now, my Savior;

bible_verses.telugu: ద్రాక్షావల్లిని నేను, తీగెలు మీరు. ఎవడు నాయందు నిలిచియుండునో నేను ఎవనియందు నిలిచి యుందునో వాడు బహుగా ఫలించును; నాకు వేరుగా ఉండి మీరేమియు చేయలేరు.
bible_verses.english: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

bible_verses.telugu: గనుక మనము కనికరింపబడి సమయోచితమైన సహాయముకొరకు కృప పొందునట్లు ధైర్యముతో కృపాసనమునొద్దకు చేరుదము.
bible_verses.english: Let us then approach God’s throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా, నేను దీనుడను దరిద్రుడను చెవియొగ్గి నాకుత్తరమిమ్ము
bible_verses.english: Hear me, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I admit how much I need You in every single hour of my life. Forgive me for the moments I try to walk in my own strength, forgetting the peace that only Your voice can bring. Stay near to me today, Lord, and let Your presence guide my thoughts and decisions. I come to You now, trusting completely in Your endless love and mercy. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I admit how much I need You in every single hour of my life. I come to You now, trusting completely in Your endless love and mercy. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often tempts us to believe we can handle everything on our own, but true peace begins when we acknowledge our continuous need for Jesus. This beloved hymn reminds us that our need for God isn't a weakness, but an invitation to abide in His grace every single hour. As you sing, open your heart to His gentle presence, trusting that He is nearby in every moment. Let this be your simple daily declaration of utter reliance on the Savior who loves you.
